How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
For the best results with a 3" x 6" pillar candle, trim the wick to 1/4" before each light. Burn it for at least 3 hours per session so the melt pool reaches near the edges to prevent tunneling.
Once the side walls are warm and soft, you can gently mold them inward toward the flame to use all the wax efficiently. To extinguish without smoke, dip the wick into the molten wax pool using a metal tool. Is there anything else I can help you with?
